completion_gate_all_required: revenue+EPS vs eligible consensus OR missing consensus disclosed
cash flow + capex analysed from reported data
management commentary incl. call reviewed when transcript available
AI impact updated with unsupported claims labelled

entry_fields.consensus_snapshot_ref: file reference or null (= NOT AVAILABLE, disclosed on card)
entry_fields.earnings_date: ISO date or null if UNKNOWN — never invented
entry_fields.fiscal_period: company's own fiscal label, e.g. Q3 FY2026
entry_fields.recurring_tracking: boolean, default false, user-enabled per ticker only
entry_fields.ticker: string, validated against a company record
